description: Which prefectural weather forecasts did JMA issue for an area between two times? Lists each archived issuance (JMA issue time, transmission time, our fetch time, scheduled/unscheduled/correction/cancellation, bulletin URL and SHA-256) with coverage gaps where JMA's feed could not be read. Free window: last 30 days (an earlier since is clamped; see history_window). Use forecast_as_issued for the content. An archive, not a forecast service.

area.description: JMA forecast office code (130000), sub-area code (130010), prefecture (Tokyo, 東京都, 13) or JMA area name (Kushiro Nemuro). Prefectures with several offices (Hokkaido, Kagoshima, Okinawa) need the office or sub-area

since.description: Issuances after this: ISO 8601 date (00:00 Japan time) or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-12 or 2026-10-12T05:00:00+09:00

until.description: Optional end: ISO 8601 date (00:00 Japan time) or date-time with time zone (default now)

name: forecast_issuances

office_archive_start.description: First issuance held for this office (JMA issue time, Japan time).

tracking_since.description: Start of the period this service has read JMA's feed (UTC).

archive_notice.description: Every answer is an archived issuance, not the current forecast and not a forecast made by this service.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

issuances.description: JMA issuances held for this office, oldest first.

official_check.description: Read first: this is an archive of what JMA issued; for current forecasts check the JMA pages listed here.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

title: List of JMA forecast issuances for an area
